entries.name: Permit2
entries.description: Signature-based token approval hub. Users grant it one ERC20 approval per token, then authorize spenders via time- and amount-bounded signed permits, revocable via lockdown. Immutable and ownerless; any spender with a valid permit can pull the permitted amount.

entries.name: Firepit
entries.description: Burn-and-release contract: anyone can transfer the configured threshold (currently 4,000 UNI) to a fixed burn address and release selected balances from its token jar to a chosen recipient. The threshold setter can change the threshold, including to zero, and the owner can replace the threshold setter.

threshold.description: Amount of the configured burn token transferred to the burn address per release call.

entries.name: Timelock
entries.description: Compound-style timelock. Its admin can queue, cancel, and execute transactions. A queued transaction becomes executable after 2d and remains executable for a 14d grace period. The delay can be changed only through the timelock itself and must remain between 2d and 1mo. After the one-time admin initialization path has been used, changing the admin requires a timelocked self-call; there is no emergency bypass.

directlyReceivedPermissions.description: can change the burn-token amount required per token-jar release.
can mint up to 2% of the token supply per mint after the minimum 1y interval, and set a new minter.
can set the voting delay, the voting period, and the proposal threshold.
can enable new fee tiers, change the feeSetter, and transfer UniswapV3Factory ownership to a new contract.
sets the protocol fee schedule (global default, per-tier defaults, per-pool overrides) that anyone can then apply to pools.
can replace the releaser and thereby redirect all held and future token balances.
can replace the governor implementation or nominate a new proxy admin; the nominee can accept and thereafter control upgrades.

delay.description: Seconds every queued transaction must wait before execution.

entries.name: UNIToken
entries.description: ERC20 governance token with checkpoint voting. Its constructor mints a fixed initial supply; the minter can mint at most 2% of supply per mint, with a minimum interval of 1y. Votes count only when delegated.

entries.name: UniswapV3Factory
entries.description: Deploys Uniswap v3 pools: anyone can create one pool per token pair and enabled fee tier, at a CREATE2 address deterministic in (token0, token1, fee). Immutable. Its owner holds exactly three powers: enable new fee tiers (irreversible), call setFeeProtocol/collectProtocol on pools, and transfer the owner role. It cannot modify, pause, or upgrade deployed pools.

owner.description: Address authorized to exercise the factory owner actions.

parameters.description: Transient slot used to pass constructor parameters to pools during CREATE2 deployment; zero outside of a pool deployment.

entries.name: GovernorBravo
entries.description: Upgradeable Governor Bravo governance proxy. Holders with more than the current proposal threshold of 1,000,000 UNI can create proposals. Voting begins 13,140 blocks after proposal creation and lasts 40,320 blocks; success requires more for-votes than against-votes and at least 40,000,000 UNI voting for. Successful proposals are queued in the configured timelock. The proxy admin can replace the implementation or nominate a new admin.

receivedPermissions.description: can change the burn-token amount required per token-jar release.
can queue, cancel, and execute timelocked transactions, and change the delay or admin (through the timelock itself).
can mint up to 2% of the token supply per mint after the minimum 1y interval, and set a new minter.
can enable new fee tiers, set the protocol fee share (up to 1/4 of LP fees per side) on any pool, collect accrued protocol fees, and transfer factory ownership.
can set the voting delay, the voting period, and the proposal threshold.
can enable new fee tiers, change the feeSetter, and transfer UniswapV3Factory ownership to a new contract.
sets the protocol fee schedule (global default, per-tier defaults, per-pool overrides) that anyone can then apply to pools.
can replace the releaser and thereby redirect all held and future token balances.
can replace the governor implementation or nominate a new proxy admin; the nominee can accept and thereafter control upgrades.

pendingAdmin.description: Address nominated to become proxy admin. It can accept the role without another action by the current admin.

votingDelay.description: Blocks between proposal submission and voting start.

proposalThreshold.description: Delegated voting tokens required to submit a proposal.

quorumVotes.description: For-votes required for a proposal to pass.

entries.name: UniversalRouter
entries.description: Command-based router that executes caller-supplied operations such as v2/v3/v4 swaps, Permit2 transfers, WETH wrapping, and token sweeps in one transaction. Immutable and unprivileged; routes are computed off-chain by the caller.

msgSender.description: Transient storage of the current caller during execution; zero at rest.

entries.name: SwapRouter02
entries.description: Swap router covering both v2 and v3 pools with multicall batching. Immutable and unprivileged: it only moves funds of callers who approved it, along routes the caller encodes.

entries.name: UniswapV3Pool_USDC_WETH_005
entries.description: A concentrated-liquidity AMM pool for one token pair at one fee tier, deployed by the factory and fully immutable: no owner, no pause, no upgrade path. LPs provide liquidity on tick ranges; swap fees accrue to in-range positions. The factory owner can divert up to 1/4 of the swap fee per side as protocol fee. Also a TWAP oracle whose observation buffer anyone can grow.

slot0.description: Current sqrtPriceX96, tick, oracle observation index/cardinality, protocol fee setting, and the reentrancy lock; changes with every swap.

protocolFees.description: Protocol fees accrued and not yet collected by the factory owner.

entries.name: NonfungiblePositionManager
entries.description: Wraps pool positions into ERC721 NFTs: it is the pool-level owner of the wrapped positions and tracks each tokenId's range, liquidity, and fees, so NFT holders manage and collect through it. Immutable and unprivileged: no special rights in the pools, which can equally be used directly.

totalSupply.description: Number of position NFTs minted so far.

entries.name: UniswapV3Pool_WBTC_WETH_03
entries.description: A concentrated-liquidity AMM pool for one token pair at one fee tier, deployed by the factory and fully immutable: no owner, no pause, no upgrade path. LPs provide liquidity on tick ranges; swap fees accrue to in-range positions. The factory owner can divert up to 1/4 of the swap fee per side as protocol fee. Also a TWAP oracle whose observation buffer anyone can grow.

slot0.description: Current sqrtPriceX96, tick, oracle observation index/cardinality, protocol fee setting, and the reentrancy lock; changes with every swap.

protocolFees.description: Protocol fees accrued and not yet collected by the factory owner.

entries.name: SwapRouter
entries.description: V3 swap router supporting single- and multi-hop exact-input and exact-output swaps. Immutable and unprivileged; it executes the route encoded by the caller.

entries.name: V3OpenFeeAdapter
entries.description: Adapter for administering a configured Uniswap v3 factory. While it holds the factory owner role, anyone can ask it to apply configured protocol fees to pools or collect accrued fees to its fixed recipient. The fee setter controls global, per-tier, and per-pool fee settings; the owner can replace the fee setter, enable factory fee tiers, or transfer factory ownership.

directlyReceivedPermissions.description: can enable new fee tiers, set the protocol fee share (up to 1/4 of LP fees per side) on any pool, collect accrued protocol fees, and transfer factory ownership.

defaultFee.description: Stored global protocol-fee fallback. The sentinel value represents an explicitly disabled fee; other nonzero values pack the token0 and token1 denominators into two 4-bit nibbles.

tier03DefaultFee.description: Resolved configured protocol fee for the 0.3% tier before any per-pool override.

entries.name: TokenJar
entries.description: Token escrow whose releaser can transfer held balances. The owner can replace the releaser, changing who controls accumulated and future deposits.

releaser.description: The only address authorized to move held tokens out.
